title: Historical V2 native QA baseline

checks.purpose: The playable story contains exactly S02/S03, 15 continuous shots and 189 seconds
Five exact original messages retain IDs, speakers, text and order
The real model is importable without browser globals
The real renderer/clock are importable without browser globals
Actual PNGs have native dimensions, alpha, distinct frames and measured opaque hand sockets

limitations: Metadata/alpha checks do not certify anatomy, foot contact, attractive artwork or runtime layout.

checks.purpose: Default createGame loader resolves every manifest image to an existing dist file

evidence.note: Filesystem-backed fetch/image-loader substitutes; actual production URL resolution and createGame path are tested. No browser.

checks.purpose: Every 60 Hz sample conserves the one loaf through all ownership transfers
Scene boundary preserves packed loaf, board and message state
No phone before break or while carrying bread; five messages follow physical phone actions
Chalk contact precedes visible progress and completed arithmetic persists
Reload roundtrip preserves ownership, chalk and chat at eleven intermediate/end times
Malformed, stale, oversized and non-finite save data fail closed
Blocked storage and quota errors do not throw or overwrite the last valid save
Unsupported preferences are sanitized into supported finite values
Non-finite/out-of-range timeline input remains inside the supported fragment
Held loaf and phone attach to the actual bitmap frame hand, not a synthetic target
All six ownership boundaries touch the prior/new object anchor within three native pixels
Drawing chalk remains at the actual hand while both feet remain on the board floor plane
Main actor feet route around the real background furniture at every 60 Hz sample

evidence.footprint: floor pivot point; visual limb/body occlusion reviewed separately

checks.purpose: Walking pupils avoid furniture except the short approach/exit to their own seated desk

evidence.limitation: Floor pivot collision check. Own-desk seating approach/exit is intentional; limb/body layering is reviewed visually.

checks.purpose: Every rendered store frame draws exactly six loaf images with one moving owner

evidence.note: Actual PNG draw calls, not inventory metadata alone. Background is the separately authored static layer.

checks.purpose: The raised pupil hand changes visible pixels above the head after furniture occlusion

evidence.requirement: At least four actual rendered pixels above head
evidence.limitation: Mechanical visibility only; gesture/anatomy/art quality are reviewed by the independent critic.

checks.purpose: Completed arithmetic renders the equals sign as two separate visible horizontal lines

evidence.source: Actual completed board segments plus final rendered pixel difference, after character/occluder drawing

checks.purpose: Pause freezes story time and resume cannot consume the paused wall-clock gap
Supported playback speeds change wall-clock rate while stalls remain bounded
Repeated player advance is continuous, visits every owner, and emits cues once
Resume restores a mid-action save and reduced motion preserves physical and message state
Quota failures produce one notice and gameplay keeps running
Every irreversible message/cue/scene/prop boundary commits before a fresh game resumes

evidence.reloadType: New createGame with same injected storage; not a browser page reload

checks.purpose: Regression evidence still matches every model/renderer/manifest file loaded by this run

limitations: Will not describe later model/art changes
